name: External Tools Settings
description: Buttons that hand a person over to another tool the organisation runs: a rich document editor (Doc AI) and a horizon-scanning platform. The platform sends each tool only a link: identifiers in the address, never a file or a record's contents.

fields.label: Doc AI (rich document editor)
fields.description: An "Open in Doc AI" button on every governing document, beside each version and on the document viewer.

fields.label: Show the Doc AI Button
fields.description: On by default. Until an address is set below, the button explains that Doc AI is not connected yet. Switch off to remove the button everywhere.

fields.label: Address Template
fields.description: An http:// or https:// address with placeholders, for example https://docai.example.internal/open?doc={document}&version={version}&title={title}&source={document_url}. Placeholders: {document} the document reference, {version} the version reference, {version_label} the version's label, {title} the document title, {document_url} the document's page in this portal. Each value is URL-encoded. Leave empty until the tool is ready.

fields.label: Only These Roles See the Button
fields.description: Leave empty for anyone who can read the document. When roles are listed, a person must hold one of them as well as be able to read the document.

fields.label: Horizon scanning platform
fields.description: A "Horizon scanning" button on the policy inventory and the regulatory updates page, and the /horizon-scanning address, which forwards to the platform.

fields.label: Show the Horizon Scanning Button
fields.description: On by default. Until an address is set below, the button explains that the platform is not connected yet.

fields.label: Address
fields.description: The platform's http:// or https:// address. Nothing is added to it.

provenance: Integrations: external tool hand-off (Doc AI, horizon scanning)
